name: smwmusic-smw-challenges-wild-lush-woods
title: SMW Challenges - Wild Lush Woods
description:
Heavily inspired by Chrono Trigger's Secret of the Forest. It's a fairly simple and calm track. Good for forests that are either extremely lush, or possibly frozen.

Omits @8, @5, @12, @17, and Thunder.brr. No star, level clear, p-switch, yoshi or thunder/blarggs.
